load_order_queue_desc: Artifacts in higher priority tiers or later in the queue load last and win file conflicts.

lo_schema_override_hint: Override the schema's default load order strategy for this workspace or configure globally in Master Schema.

lo_move_down: Move Later in Load Order (Higher Priority)
lo_no_rules_subtitle: Create 'Load After' or 'Load Before' rules to automatically control which artifact wins conflicts.
lo_sorted_toast: Load order compiled from active rules and priority tiers.
spoke_quick_bundle_ph: Paste a SANCTUARY-UPLINK:// token, JSON bundle, or raw Supabase URL & keys...

wf_uplink_keys_updated: Spoke uplink keys verified and updated on the Hub.
wf_cut_cord_desc: Unilaterally sever your community's Spoke database from the Sanctuary OS Hub. This immediately deactivates the workspace on the global network and purges your Service Role Key from the Hub while leaving 100% of your Spoke database intact.
wf_cut_cord_reason_ph: Optional reason for severing the uplink (logged to Audit Trail)...
wf_cut_cord_confirm_btn: Confirm: Click Again to Permanently Sever Uplink

lo_panel_subtitle: Configure priority tier, load sequence, and dependency rules
lo_tier_select_desc: Assign this artifact to an elevated priority tier so it loads later and wins conflicts.
lo_rule_builder_desc: Lock explicit load order dependencies between two artifacts.
lo_sequence_desc: Adjust where this artifact loads within its priority tier.
lo_custom_empty_desc: All artifacts are currently using default load order. Click '+' in the header or switch to Full Queue to configure an artifact.
lo_strategy_folder_desc: Uses priority override folders and packed directory depth
lo_strategy_manifest_desc: Writes an ordered plain-text manifest file on deployment

lo_strategy_timestamp_desc: Staggers file modification timestamps by load sequence
lo_no_rules_desc: Add a load rule or pick a conflict winner to automatically lock load order dependencies.
lo_cycle_desc: Two or more artifacts are locked in an infinite load-order loop. Break one rule below to restore sorting.
pwa_install_desc: Install Sanctuary OS directly to your home screen or app drawer for a full-screen standalone experience with instant workspace access.
pwa_banner_subtitle: Add the Sanctuary PWA to your home screen
pwa_guide_subtitle: Install Sanctuary OS as a standalone app
pwa_ios_step1_desc: Tap the Share icon at the bottom or top of Safari.
pwa_ios_step2_desc: Scroll down the share sheet and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.
pwa_ios_step3_desc: Tap 'Add' in the top-right corner. Sanctuary OS will now open in full-screen standalone mode.
pwa_android_step1_desc: Tap the three-dot menu icon in Chrome or your mobile browser.
pwa_android_step2_title: 2. Tap 'Install App' or 'Add to Home screen'
pwa_android_step2_desc: Confirm the prompt to add Sanctuary OS to your app drawer and home screen.
pwa_status_installed: Sanctuary OS installed to your device!
desc_static_manifest_url: Point this local artifact hash and its family to a hosted static manifest.json for automatic background updates and atomic logic.
msg_export_release_success: Exported manifest.json, override.json, and release .zip to artifact folder!
